concerns.text: Task T014 (Static Analysis) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T010 (Repo Selection) and T011 (Git History) to provide the repository list and file paths. The task description states 'Depends on: T010, T011, T013', yet the [P] tag implies it can run independently or in parallel with those tasks. This is a hidden ordering violation; T014 must be sequential after T011/T013.

Task T015a (Filtering) is marked [P] but depends on T014 (Static Analysis) and T011 (Git History) to produce the input files (`commits.csv` and `semgrep_results.json`). The task description explicitly lists 'Depends on: T014'. Marking it [P] suggests it can run in parallel with its producers, violating the producer-before-consumer dependency flow.

Task T022 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Correlation) which in turn depends on T015a. The task description states 'Depends on: T015a, T020'. The [P] tag is incorrect as T022 cannot execute until T020 completes. This creates a false parallel opportunity in the execution plan.

Task T028b (Report File) is marked [P] but depends on T020, T021, and T022. The task description explicitly lists these dependencies. The [P] tag is invalid as the task cannot run until all three analysis tasks complete.

Task T031 (Versioning) is marked [P] but depends on T028b (Report File). The task description states 'Depends on: T028b'. The [P] tag is incorrect; this is a final sequential step that cannot run in parallel with the reporting task it finalizes.

Task T032a-2 (Quickstart Exec) is marked [P] but depends on T007e and T032a-1. The task description states 'Depends on: T007e, T032a-1'. The [P] tag is invalid as it requires the output of T032a-1 (Installation section) to be present.

Task T036 (Quickstart Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T032a-1 and T032a-2. The task description states 'Depends on: T032a-1, T032a-2'. The [P] tag is invalid; validation cannot occur until the quickstart document is fully written.

Task T041 (Data Loader Hardening) is marked [P] but depends on T011. The task description states 'Depends on: T011'. The [P] tag is incorrect as it requires the logic from T011 to be present to refactor it.
Task T042 (Dataset Sourcing) is marked [P] but depends on T010. The task description states 'Depends on: T010'. The [P] tag is incorrect as it refactors logic within the task defined in T010.
